summary.title: Production Wiki Compiler
summary.one_sentence_summary: Production Wiki Compiler turns source articles into visible wiki pages.
key_insights: The local contract must preserve summary, concept, and entity outputs.
Concept and entity drafts need stable canonical names for deduplication.

claims.text: Production Wiki Compiler keeps summary pages separate from concept and entity pages.

concepts.definition: 把原始 source 编译成 summary、concept、entity 页的本地流程。
key_points: 生成人类可见的概念页
保留 source 到 summary 的引用关系

entities.profile: 用于浏览生成后 wiki graph 的本地知识库界面。
key_points: 可见 summary 和 concept/entity 链接
